Download Game - https://blackphoenixproductions.itch.io/satori

To play this game it's important to use headphones or good quality speakers because many of the game's puzzles requires you to listen carefully to the music and game effects.

The default graphic setting is medium but you can change it in the options menu accessibile via the start/pause menu.
